payload.label: Chat
payload.description: Product shell over owner-owned conversation materializations, source atoms, owner actions, and process/session proof records. It reads and routes; it does not own transcripts, providers, process events, or domain outcomes.

payload.name: publish-materialized-chat-session-transcripts
payload.description: Publish durable session_transcript facts to the materialized transcript overlay feed.

payload.name: publish-chat-sessions
payload.description: Read canonical chat_session attribute facts and publish the addressed chat-sessions sink payload.

payload.name: publish-chat-sidebar-panel
payload.description: Read chat sidebar panel owner facts and publish the addressed chat-sidebar-panel sink payload.

payload.name: rename-chat-session
payload.description: Write prop:chat_session:title on the canonical chat_session owner.

payload.name: update-chat-sidebar-panel
payload.description: Write prop:chat_sidebar_panel:state on the chat sidebar panel owner.

payload.name: materialize-chat-session-window
payload.description: Materialize the chat conversation list from descriptor-named observed-content sources and decoder capabilities.

payload.name: read-chat-conversation-page
payload.description: Read one bounded page of conversation rows already retained by Chat. This action never scans or opens source files and does not claim coverage of history discarded before page retention was installed.

payload.name: run-source-producers
payload.description: Run each connected conversation source through a statically admitted package-owned producer action. Source DATA selects only an action from definition_refs; it cannot provide a command, script, working directory, environment, or timeout.

payload.name: decode-one-record-source
payload.description: Read one record-backed conversation snapshot through its declared Envelope address, then hand only those record bytes to the contained decoder.

payload.name: decode-one-acquired-file-source
payload.description: Read one bounded set of local conversation files without changing the originals, then hand only those bytes to the contained conversation decoder. Missing, refused or partially readable files remain unavailable and retryable.

payload.name: decode-one-ranged-file-source
payload.description: Read one bounded tail range from each newest local conversation file through the stable Local Files range owner, then decode only that current window. Older bytes remain addressable through the returned cursor; missing or unstable revisions remain unavailable and retryable.

payload.name: decode-one-source
payload.description: Decode one conversation source for the sidebar using the acquisition shape selected by its descriptor. Non-file observers retain their declared read path. A file source must arrive with bytes from the bounded Local Files action; missing or partial acquisition remains unavailable and retryable instead of silently opening the person's original files or recording the source as empty.

payload.name: acquire-selected-jsonl-range
payload.description: Read one bounded tail range from each newest local conversation file through the stable Local Files range owner, then decode only that current window. Older bytes remain addressable through the returned cursor; missing or unstable revisions remain unavailable and retryable.

payload.name: read-chat-session-transcript-page
payload.description: Read one bounded transcript page by composing source descriptors with their decoder capability.
